assumptions: Add ECC is disabled ("false") to match DSENT's DFFRAM, which carries no ECC overhead of its own.

Optimize ED or ED^2 is set to "NONE" so the weight/deviate design objective (100:0:0:0:0, i.e. minimize delay only) actually determines the chosen organization -- leaving it at ED or ED^2 would silently override the weight/deviate settings.

CACTI's area figure includes array periphery (decoders, sense amps, H-tree wiring, drivers) and internal routing overhead, whereas DSENT's area_ram sums bare cell (DFF + mux) footprints only. The two area numbers therefore carry opposite biases -- CACTI trends high, DSENT trends low -- and are not apples-to-apples without adjustment.
